questions: Were you unconscious during the episode?
Were you confused, drowsy, or unable to remember things afterward?
Have you ever had a seizure before?
Did you bite your tongue or lose bladder control during it?
Were both sides of your body shaking?
Did you have a warning or strange feeling (smell, taste, déjà vu, rising sensation) before it began?
Are you known to have epilepsy?
Did it last longer than one minute?
Have you had a fever, infection, or been ill recently?
Do you drink alcohol daily, or did you recently stop after heavy drinking?
Have you hit your head or sustained any injury during the episode?
Do you take any regular medications (or did you recently miss doses)?
Has anyone in your close family had epilepsy or seizures?
Do you have any known heart problems or have you ever fainted before?
Was anyone else present who could describe what happened?
